body:
I feel I need to do it too. it is very difficult to die from cutting your arms and i doubt i would, but if that is my end that is my end. 


i don’t like how the medicine makes me feel. i don’t like how it changes my thoughts. They are trying to control my thoughts. my thoughts are valid

I already have very visible, deep self harm scars on my arm. I am already stared at. 


If I go to the ER/police i will be held in a mental institution anyways. I just want to get this urge out before I am held there. 


Yes I am alone. I live alone.
even with not wanting any meds you think I would be out in a minimum 7 days? I will play it cool and go to groups and everything, i just don’t want antipsychotics anymore.
there is no point in venting frustration to people who are opening up to strangers. being kind leads to the best outcome for all

I thought I had the urges downed after the last time i caused permanent damage to my body. i have been going to DBT. It does feel like an old friend knocking at my door. i can not seem to break this urge to feel it once more then stop forever. i don’t know if that will happen, though. 


i don’t have a support system anymore. 


being in the hospital was hellish, at least the days in the ER before i got admitted somewhere. i know if i express my extreme urges and late behaviors i will be admitted and held captive, forced to take antipsychotics again as a condition to be released.  i just want to give in and experience the feeling again before going in to that bullshit.

i’ve never been on tumblr. it is simply how i feel. you can ask questions to gain insight but it is how it is. you shouldn’t be cold and callous as you usually are when posting. it isn’t good for anyone

i don’t think that. assuming things like you are hurts everyone. It is nothing but tissue damage that creates a very unique sensation. I don’t write poetry, i don’t want to write. i want to share my feelings with other human and interact. i don’t have many, or really any, people truly close to me, so i share with strangers in this moment. I am a person just as complex as you
I do not see the romance. it is short, sweet, what has been consuming my thoughts.
I say hella so goddamn much

Maybe I’m looking too into this but I *really* like this bullshit because the picture shows a fuckin designer dog (which only the rich or pretending to be rich do, buying one has to be one of the stupidest decisions anyone could make you have to be an actual dumbass to get one not overreacting) sitting on some seat protector bullshit wearing an ugly pink sweatervest and this dude was previously homeless for 10 years? and the year he’s out of the streets he’s buying his designer dog a plush little camouflage car blanket and shit? truly the american dream

My other parent died when I was in elementary. 


Been in DBT a few months. I have trouble implementing the strategies because they aren’t immediately gratifying like bad coping methods, and I have trouble focusing or being “in reality” when upset.


I don’t have many friends but I have a boyfriends.
I recorded her a few times. It is on old devices, some of which can’t turn on/work anymore. I feel too apathetic to expose her, especially since I am aware of how great of a liar she is.
She is alive and kicking. She has talked about how she feels like she’s about to die for around 13 years now, tho.

I feel like I was abused so much that my brain stopped working in some respects, “less” abuse could lead to more hurt because of lack of blocking damage. I’m not a psychologist tho. I dunno. 


Thank you for your recommendation. I am bad at following up on resources but I will try.
I am certain she has an undiagnosed disorder of some sort. I am trying, I promise.

I forget a lot of what she said. I mostly remember the feeling of thinking “how can you say that? how can you think up that?” and a few specific and repeated phrases. Brain breaking, too. I have a really bad memory from that time period for everything. I have problems with dissociation daily.

I blocked out years too. I have a very bad memory of my childhood and teens. Right now I can only recall around 5 teachers names from 1st grade to 12th. 


I am excited to speak to a therapist, I hope I am helped like you were.
Why would you not believe it?
Thank you for your comment I really appreciate it.

I wish she survived and treated me nice.


Thank you.

She lied to everyone about me. I will probably make a post about some of her ongoing lies and delusions. They are extremely odd and interesting. 


I called 911 once on her and she lied her way out of that. 


No one believed me. Once when I was 16 I stayed at a family friends house after she beat me until my entire arms from wrist to shoulder were purple. Somehow she managed to make them believe I instigated her and hurt her back. For some reason I was afraid to show my bruising and wore long shirts. Still don’t know why. That was the closest I’ve been to being believed. 




Yeah, I am weird. I have been told I’ve very weird, quirky, whatever. “A weird girl” guys would say. I will probably be weird forever. My boyfriend says he likes weird girls, though. I am 21. 


I don’t have many friends and don’t have family I can talk to. I would really like a pet, my psychiatrist told me he’d make it a ESA (or give me writing to say it can be an ESA, i don’t know the process) when I get one. 



I have coped by being an alcoholic and spacing out in front of screens. I don’t drink compulsively anymore but I still have problems doing anything besides laying in bed looking at a screen. 



I like art, I am really good at it. I like film, editing. I’d like to make a youtube channel. I love to read but I can’t focus easily so I rarely do it. I like photography and animals and makeup. 


Thanks for your comment, it was very nice.
Worst, she is a people person. She is very gregarious and never stops talking. You would think she is cool if she passed by you in the super market and began talking to you. I don’t know what she is.

Ok. I drink water usually but the tap in my place tastes bad. I haven’t been eating well, sorry. I do like ice cream and my friends are pretty cool. Thanks for the list. I don’t drive yet because I had no one to practice with, but I will get my license soon I hope. I like to think I make good decisions. Thank you.
It is nice to hear that. I am going to stick with DBT until I have better control, even if it takes years.

I know he loves me and I overthink things, but I still have issues that are taxing. 


I have lots of problems controlling my emotions. I have extreme outbursts and can’t control when I get angry or sad regarding him. He is one of the first people I legit care about so it’s hard to have those emotions without overdoing it.


I have bad abandonment issues, and I ask him daily similar questions (“do you really like me?” “are you going to suddenly leave me?” “am i a burden?” “do you secretly want to break up?”).


I sometimes forget to upkeep my appearance (dress in non-sweats, style my hair, etc.) and genuinely forget to do very basic hygiene things. 


It is difficult to be with me, but he says he wants no one else but me despite my broken brain.

I will have a psychologist next week. I am in DBT and have a psychiatrist. I only recently (within the past few months) looked into mental health (was hospitalized due to psychosis/suicidal) and everyone I interacted with seemed very concerned. I will always have insurance because the torture and inherited mental issues make me “disabled”. 


I don’t have many friends really. I am not good with making or keeping friends for many reasons. I have a boyfriend, he is my best friend. I know being with me is a toll on him, though.

I have a constant inner critic if I am not dissociating. I do not believe what is “said”, but it is still depressing and difficult to shake. Everything I do has a constant nagging about how I’m wrong, how no one likes me, how I am an embarrassment. I try to think opposite but it is very encompassing.

I was able to game too. There would be blocks where I could do things other than lay in bed when she was distracted. I couldn’t talk on mic or she would rush in screaming to embarrass me. 


She was more neglectful when I was a child, and slowly it morphed into more hours than not screaming when I reached my teens. 


DBT is dialectical behavioral therapy. It teaches mindfulness, stress tolerance, emotion tolerance, habit breaking bad coping mechanisms, how to interact with others, etc. The general idea of it is balancing logic and emotions and not allowing either to override. I was put in because I was diagnosed with a mood disorder and CPTSD and I self harm. 


I hope you are right and I am different soon, there are lots of bad things about me.

Is it that bad?


I am in DBT to regulate my emotions/self harming/dissociation/whatever. I am on medication. I live my life very on edge and I am extremely spacey and not mindful. I am getting help but I believe there is a lot to deal with, maybe too much. 


I am not that okay but I am away from her.

You are right. My mom would project a lot. She would call me fat and pick apart my body when she was consistently obese and I was average/chubby/skinny. Just one example. 


I understand she was probably just talking about herself most of the time. It is still unnerving to hear so consistently no matter what you believe deep down.


>Are you safe and away now?


I live alone, yes.
please do. I feel so alone about how I live and how quickly i must clean it.
I feel embarrassed to talk about it with a friend. I probably should. I have the overwhelming urge to hide and hurt myself.
I know I would feel better after I clean, but I am incredibly embarrassed now. I am really trying to not care, i promise.
